claim: Dr. Anthony Fauci said of Trump’s pandemic response, “I can’t imagine that … anybody could be doing more.”
justification: High-confidence evidence from the retrieval-based and knowledge-only fact-checks (confidence scores 0.85-0.95) corroborates that Dr. Anthony Fauci made a statement in a March 2020 Fox News interview containing the phrase 'I can’t imagine that … anybody could be doing more' in reference to President Donald Trump's pandemic response. The low-confidence evidence about the October 10, 2020 date (confidence 0.20) is contradicted and discounted, but the core claim is substantiated by multiple credible sources affirming the quote and its context.
